scope: Posthoc arithmetic audit, not model replay or segmentation validation.
checks: Query geometry exactly matches independently recomputed detail/CNN dimensions and bottom/right padding.
Every51-window grid maps to direct original-image formulas independently of resize code.
All learned proposal coordinates invert to integer CNN connected-component boxes.
Reference supplied boxes and normalized transformed boxes match manifest and recorded crop/scales.
All selected and best-proposal IoUs independently recomputed with scalar arithmetic over all target boxes.
limitation: This rejects these coordinate bookkeeping explanations; it does not prove intended object segmentation, semantic matching, or absence of every implementation defect.
